piece.headline: ALESTON GRABS FIRST PLACE, FERNANDES ARMBANDS DO THE DAMAGE
piece.standfirst: Aleston leads by 2 after a week of Fernandes armbands. Sidharth went for Tzolis instead and paid for it.
piece.big_picture: Aleston takes top spot from Rajat Arora and leads Arshad and Prathap by 2. Most of the league had the same armband on B.Fernandes, so the gap came from elsewhere. With margins this thin, one captain call next week could flip the table.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sidharth captained Tzolis instead of B.Fernandes. Tzolis scored 0, while the armband on Fernandes would have brought 46. That is the biggest swing of the week. Bold, lonely and costly.

winners.name: Ketan
winners.verdict: Bench Boost, the right armband and a huge leap to 6th. The chip added nothing, so this was all captain and squad. Clean work.

winners.name: Biswadeep
winners.verdict: Fernandes armband, Bench Boost and a 73-place climb to 12th. The boost scored nothing from the bench, so the starting XI did all the work. Class.

winners.name: Abhishek Yerra
winners.verdict: Climbed 65 places to 37th with the armband on B.Fernandes. Bench Boost gave zip, so the main squad earned it. Good week's work.

losers.name: Rohan
losers.verdict: Isak was a reasonable armband pick, but 14 points stayed on the bench. Unlucky more than daft.

losers.name: Krishna
losers.verdict: Palmer as captain brought 14 points, while the rest of the league cashed in elsewhere. Now 112th, one place from the foot. A tough fortnight.
